metadata.device: Galaxy S26 Ultra SM-S948U R3CY70LV96T, DSP v81
metadata.baseline_build: git archive 5e97254; generated its own RPC stub and rebuilt Android engine and CausalLM with same NDK/options. Existing tokenizer/JSON/XGrammar build dependencies reused. Filtered grid instrumentation is the same in both builds. DSP/provider libraries held constant.

interrupted_unmodified_4096.result_json: all NUL bytes after reboot; not usable as measurements

host_verification.asan_ubsan_snapshot: passed; owned lifetime and exact payload size assertions

cached_cohort_driver.difference_from_final_driver: Final driver flushes progress after warmup/each producer and validates prefill rows before narrowing; timed model calls and configuration are unchanged.

cooling.current: No external fan; user reports fan is broken.
cooling.historical_reference: Historical sparse 1024 report used a fan; user permits accounting for the current cooling difference.
cooling.comparison_policy: Use fresh same-device baseline5e/current controls for regression; do not attribute historical-to-current timing differences solely to code. Clocks and thermal state are not locked.

historical_original_dsp.evidence: Exact match to original grid/pre-baking binary manifests. Prepared for an additional original-DSP comparison, but NOT EXECUTED after device became unavailable. Common-DSP runs isolate host implementation changes.

second_disconnect.interpretation: The new disconnect occurred in cold-only mode with sparse/session/prefix controls disabled. The cause of device instability is unresolved; source retention alone is insufficient to explain it.

completion.status: limited device validation; stopped at user request after device became unavailable
completion.real_model_prebaked_4k_8k: not executed; host/device baked artifact and snapshot checks passed
completion.long_run_device_stability: not established; second ADB disconnect occurred with sparse disabled and no retained prefix source

local_evidence_archive.contents: Full input arrays for available reports (including the incomplete cold report), analysis/runner scripts and host logs; no model weights or executables.
